classical.description: A classical, refined style for historical and xianxia themes.
classical.name: Classical Elegance
classical.requirements:
Writing style requirements:
1. Use classical or semi-classical Chinese
2. Classical poetic imagery
3. Focus on mood and lingering charm
4. Keep dialogue and description classically beautiful

humorous.description: A witty, humorous style for light, funny stories.
humorous.name: Lighthearted Humor
humorous.requirements:
Writing style requirements:
1. Lively, playful language
2. Comedic dialogue
3. Well-placed exaggeration and reversals
4. Keep the tone light and fun

literary.description: A literary, delicate style focused on psychology and atmosphere.
literary.name: Literary and Delicate
literary.requirements:
Writing style requirements:
1. Inner monologue and emotional detail
2. Use setting to build atmosphere
3. Beautiful, literary language
4. Metaphor and symbolism

modern.description: A modern minimalist style for light novels and fast-paced web fiction.
modern.name: Modern Minimalist
modern.requirements:
Writing style requirements:
1. Direct, information-dense language
2. Let dialogue drive the plot
3. Avoid lengthy description; highlight key actions
4. Brisk pacing for fast reading

natural.description: A natural, fluent narrative style for modern urban and real-life themes.
natural.name: Natural Flow
natural.requirements:
Writing style requirements:
1. Concise language close to modern speech
2. Short sentences and smooth pacing
3. Natural emotional detail
4. Avoid over-embellishment and complex syntax

suspense.description: A tense suspense style for mystery and thriller themes.
suspense.name: Tense Suspense
suspense.requirements:
Writing style requirements:
1. Build oppressive tension
2. Short sentences, faster rhythm
3. Set up suspense and foreshadowing
4. Detail-oriented, planting clues
